caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden chair positioned near the center of a plain, light-colored background. The chair is brown and has a flat seat supported by four legs, with the two back legs extending upward to form the backrest. The backrest is tall and elaborately carved with symmetrical decorative patterns, giving it an intricate and ornate appearance. The seat appears angled slightly, and the legs are straight, with a horizontal stretcher connecting the two front legs. There are no other objects or elements visible in the composition, and the overall appearance is minimal against the pale backdrop. In the lower right corner, there is a handwritten note identifying the artist and date: "Francis A. Jennings, Del. 1821."
title: Three Legged Chair
